description: Compare two sets of texts and report the closest match and any near-duplicates. When deduplicating or matching records by text similarity. Do not choose this when semantic similarity is required across different vocabulary. Example requests: Find near-duplicate texts between these two sets. | Compare these two sets of texts for overlap. | Which of these records are duplicates of each other?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

texts_a.description: The customer's texts_a.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. First set, one text per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

texts_b.description: The customer's texts_b.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Second set, one text per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_embedding_similarity_report
title: Embedding similarity report
